statement: agp-Cockpit is the owner's private tool and is not published. A release is private: version bump, changelog entry, annotated git tag, a local app build and, created by the owner by hand, a GitHub Release entry in the private repository (visible only to the owner). No PyPI package, no Zenodo record. No Zenodo record exists for this repository; none may be created, updated or queried. Cockpit work orders never create, edit or delete GitHub Releases.
allowed: annotated git tag (pushing it is a remote effect and needs the owner's approval)
GitHub Release entry in the private repository, created by the owner by hand (owner_github_release)

tag_push.condition: after the owner's approval of the release run

owner_github_release.by: the owner, by hand (gh release create --verify-tag)
owner_github_release.condition: repository stays private; the tag exists; no Zenodo integration enabled for the repository

signed_kit_commands.rule: The Kit's private release route (Kit 1.0.16, KIT-GF-038): the dry run is free and prints an approval signature; the live run needs --execute --allow-execute --expected-signature <that signature> and the owner's approval; .agentic/config.yaml must declare publication: none (tag push only, no GitHub Release, PyPI or Zenodo); never the marker file .agentic/release/ENABLE_LIVE_PUBLISH.
